cues.text: Watch F1 Finance's accounting machine roll forward HANGS Construction's fixed assets.
First it ties the asset register to the ledger.
Next it tests each new October asset against its bill.
Equipment carries its full cost, including delivery, setup and sales tax.
A repair and some small purchases come off the register.
Then disposals: a trailer sold in October still sits in the ledger.
Then it recomputes depreciation and rolls every account forward to the ledger.
It proposes three entries, about $64,000 in all, for the controller to review.
All done. The roll-forward ties to the ledger at about $322,000 of cost, with five exceptions for a person. Nothing was posted; the controller approves each entry.
Jumping to the results. A person still reviews every item before anything is posted, paid or sent.
